unavailable.title: Jobs are not available here
unavailable.body: This version of DIASPORALE does not serve job offers or talents yet: nothing is made up in their place.

network.label: Visible in the talent search
network.hint: Network members find you by country and skill, under your short name, with no contact details.

unlisted.label: Hidden from search
unlisted.hint: Nobody finds you: the profile is only attached to the applications where you choose it.

search.title: Jobs in the diaspora
search.lead: Offers posted by the network's companies and associations. Your application is private: only the page's team reads it.
search.label: Search for a job offer
search.cityHint: Type the city: no location is requested.

results.title: Offers
results.label: Offers found
results.emptyBody: Only open offers from the network's companies and associations appear.
results.emptyFilters: Try without the city, without the contract, or in another country.

offer.unavailableBody: It may have been suspended or closed, or its deadline has passed.
offer.badgeNote: The badge says who the page is; it does not vouch for the offer.
offer.noContact: No contact details: you apply on DIASPORALE and the page's team answers you here.
offer.manageNote: You manage this offer on behalf of the page.

apply.title: Apply: {{offer}}
apply.description: Your message goes to the team of {{page}}, and to them alone.
apply.messageHint: At least {{min}} characters. No phone, email, link or address.
apply.profileHidden: Your talent profile is hidden: reactivate it in Talents to attach it.
apply.noProfile: You don't have a talent profile.
apply.reminder: No contact details in the message: the team will answer you through DIASPORALE. You are never asked for your age, sex, origin, family situation or a photo.
apply.consent: I agree that the team of {{page}} sees my published name and this message.
apply.sentBody: The team of {{page}} will read it; follow its status in My applications.
apply.statusInsufficient: Your status does not allow applying yet: ask for a sponsorship or verify your consular registration.
apply.closed: This offer no longer accepts applications.
apply.changed: The offer changed since you read it: read it again before applying.

mine.title: My applications
mine.lead: Your applications are private: only the page's team reads them. Withdrawing an application is final.
mine.label: My applications
mine.emptyBody: Open offers from the network's companies and associations are waiting for you.
mine.unknownPage: a page that can no longer be read
mine.offerClosed: This offer no longer accepts applications.
mine.confirmWithdrawBody: This is final: the team of {{page}} will only see its status, and you won't be able to apply to this offer again.

note.sent: Sent: the page's team has not opened it yet.
note.seen: Seen: the page's team has read it.
note.shortlisted: Shortlisted: the page's team kept your application for the next step.
note.not_selected: Not selected: the page did not take your application further.
note.withdrawn: Withdrawn: you took this application back.

talents.title: Diaspora talents
talents.lead: A talent profile is optional: you choose what it shows and who sees it. Searches go country by country, with no contact details.
talents.privacyNote: These profiles are published voluntarily by their owners, under a short name. No contact details are shown and no list can be downloaded.
talents.declaredNote: Skills are declared by each person: a consular attestation says who a person is, not what they can do.
talents.skillHint: One word is enough: accounting, cooking, translation…
talents.label: Talents found
talents.emptyTitle: No visible talent for these criteria
talents.emptyBody: Only active profiles that their owners make visible in the network appear.

profile.title: My talent profile
profile.lead: Optional and revocable: hide it or delete it at any time.
profile.emptyTitle: You don't have a talent profile
profile.emptyBody: Create one to be found by the network's companies and associations, or to attach it to your applications.
profile.fieldTitleHint: Your trade or what you are looking for, in one line.
profile.fieldSkillsHint: One per line, {{max}} at most, {{length}} characters each at most.
profile.fairness: No age, sex, origin, family situation or photo: this information is never requested. Your skills are declared by you.
profile.optIn: I choose to publish this talent profile; I can hide it or delete it at any time.
profile.hiddenNote: Hidden: your profile appears neither in search nor in your applications.
profile.confirmRemoveBody: It leaves the search and the applications where you attached it. You can create another one later.

recruiter.title: The page's job offers
recruiter.lead: Post an offer on behalf of the page; applications arrive here and stay private.
recruiter.cannotPublish: Your status does not allow posting on behalf of the page yet.
recruiter.emptyBody: An offer starts as a draft or open; suspend or close it whenever you want.
recruiter.confirmCloseBody: This is final: the offer no longer accepts applications. Those already received remain readable here.
recruiter.applicationsLead: Private: only the page's signatories read them. No contact details are exchanged here.
recruiter.noApplicationsBody: Applications to this offer will appear here.
recruiter.teamNote: Team note, never shown to the person: {{note}}
recruiter.withdrawnNote: The person withdrew their application: only its status remains.
recruiter.rejectBody: The person will only see “Not selected”. The reason stays a team note.
recruiter.reasonHint: A note for the team, never shown to the person. No contact details.

form.title: Job title
form.descriptionHint: At least {{min}} characters: tasks, hours, useful experience. No phone, email, link or address.
form.payMinHint: Leave empty to advertise a maximum only.
form.deadlineHint: Until the end of that day, time zone {{zone}}. Six months at most.
form.fairness: Do not require age, sex, origin, family situation or a photo. No contact details: applications arrive on DIASPORALE.
form.conflictTitle: The offer changed in the meantime
form.conflictBody: Another team member edited it. Reload the latest version before saving.

hub.lead: Open offers from companies and associations — {{country}}.
hub.emptyBody: The country's companies and associations post their offers here.

offer.pending_review: Under moderation review: members cannot see the offer until a decision is made.
offer.removed: Removed by moderation: members no longer see the offer and can no longer apply.

application.pending_review: Under moderation review: the page's team cannot see it before a decision is made.
application.removed: Removed by moderation: the page's team no longer sees it.

talent.pending_review: Under moderation review: your profile appears neither in search nor in your applications before a decision is made.
talent.removed: Removed by moderation: your profile no longer appears in search or in your applications.

errors.job_title_too_short: The title has at least 3 characters.
errors.job_title_too_long: The title has at most 120 characters.
errors.job_description_too_short: The description has at least 30 characters.
errors.job_description_too_long: The description has at most 4,000 characters.
errors.job_contact_details_forbidden: Remove phone numbers, email addresses, links and exact addresses: contact goes through DIASPORALE.
errors.job_contract_invalid: Choose a contract from the list.
errors.job_country_is_home: Choose a diaspora country of residence: Gabon is not one of them.
errors.job_city_too_long: The city has at most 80 characters.
errors.job_pay_period_invalid: Choose a period for the pay.
errors.job_pay_range_invalid: The maximum must be above zero and not below the minimum.
errors.job_deadline_invalid: The deadline must be ahead, within the next six months.
errors.job_query_too_long: The search has at most 100 characters.
errors.job_offer_closed: This offer is closed: it can be neither edited nor reopened.
errors.job_offer_transition_invalid: This status change is not possible for this offer.
errors.job_offer_version_conflict: The offer changed in the meantime: reload it before trying again.
errors.job_offer_limit_reached: This page already holds the maximum number of offers that are not closed.
errors.job_page_kind_not_allowed: Only company and association pages post job offers.
errors.job_offer_changed: The offer changed since you read it: read it again before applying.
errors.job_application_message_too_short: Your message has at least 20 characters.
errors.job_application_message_too_long: Your message has at most 3,000 characters.
errors.job_application_consent_required: Tick the box to agree that the page's team sees your name and your message.
errors.job_application_own_page: You cannot apply to offers from a page you are a signatory of.
errors.job_application_already_exists: You have already applied to this offer.
errors.job_application_idempotency_conflict: A different submission already left with this form: check your applications, then try again.
errors.job_application_transition_invalid: This action is no longer possible for this application.
errors.job_decision_reason_too_long: The reason has at most 500 characters.
errors.job_talent_profile_unavailable: Your talent profile is missing or hidden: it cannot be attached.
errors.talent_title_too_short: The title has at least 3 characters.
errors.talent_title_too_long: The title has at most 100 characters.
errors.talent_visibility_invalid: Choose who can see this profile.
errors.talent_profile_version_conflict: Your profile changed in the meantime: reload the page before trying again.
errors.talent_opt_in_required: Tick the box to confirm that you choose to publish this profile.
